title: [PDF] mTOR as a central regulator of lifespan and aging[version 1
abstract: Abbreviations 4E-BP, eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E (eIF4E)-binding protein; AD, Alzheimer’s disease; AKT, protein kinase B; ATF4, activating transcription factor 4; ATF6, acti-vating transcription factor 6;
